title: GET /tournaments/:id/players/:pid/card response
description: One player's card, for anyone on the tournament (arbiters included): the player as the players list has them, rank and score as the standings have them, and every game so far, as the printed Players Card reads it. 404 not_found for a player not in the tournament.

score.description: The score the standings rank on.

games.description: One per round the player has a record in, by round. A round still being played without a result is not here yet.

result.description: From the player's side, as the card prints it: "1", "½", "0", "1FF", "0FF", "1 bye", "½ bye", "0 bye", "*" (postponed), or "".
